one_line_contribution: A variance-components measurement of leave-one-out counterfactual credit for individual items in an ALFWorld experience bank: it asks whether same-class items differ in true value by more than re-run noise, and converts the answer into a reliability-versus-re-run curve, a winner's-curse retention rate and a re-run price for a pruning decision.
closest_prior_work: Data Banzhaf (arxiv:2205.15466, VERIFIED via s2cli paper: AISTATS, 196 citations). It already establishes the mechanism the proposal treats as its discovery — that under a stochastic learning algorithm the LOO and Shapley value of a datum is noise-dominated and its rank unstable, and that the estimator choice, not the data, determines whether a rank survives — and it formalizes rank stability under noise as a safety-margin quantity. Efficient Shapley by amortization (arxiv:2305.19998, VERIFIED, ACL) independently reports that estimated Shapley values are sensitive to random seed. On the measurement side, Signal and Noise (arxiv:2508.13144, VERIFIED, NeurIPS 2025) performs exactly this decomposition — spread across units versus replicate noise, and the reliability consequences for decisions made on it — one level up, at benchmark/model rather than item level. Together these do not pre-empt the proposal: none decomposes item value into a between-item component and a re-run component, none measures a stochastic multi-step agent value function, and none prices a per-item rank in re-runs. But they do remove the conceptual surprise. What is left as new is the object (retrieved experience consumed by an agent) and the numbers, not the idea that per-item value estimates are noise-dominated. That is a real but modest contribution, and it is what caps novelty at 6.
strongest_objection: The headline null is measured in the one cell where the design makes it nearly automatic. In composition C1 the HOLE set retains two correct same-type expert exemplars, so by the proposal's own arithmetic any helpful item's marginal is bounded by k3 - k2, about 4 net. P1 then claims tau_E < 5 net with a CI upper bound below 8. A between-item SD of true credit cannot exceed the ceiling on the credits themselves, so tau_E < 5 in C1 is close to a consequence of the composition rather than a finding about expert items — an 8-net within-class SD among correct experts could arise only through actively harmful E items, which the design neither plants nor controls. The proposal's estimator gate does not rescue this: the gate is passed by the pooled E+W class, whose spread is planted between classes by harmful items, and it therefore certifies only that the estimator can see between-class spread, never that C1 can express within-class spread among helpful items. Worse, the composition where the item is the sole same-type carrier (C2) — the only cell where a genuine within-class item effect could be expressed — is funded at 16 E items x 8 games x 2 seeds, i.e. 16 paired re-runs per item (per-item SE about 12.7, error variance ~163). tau_E is simply not estimable there. So the paper as budgeted can produce its headline null only in the cell that cannot falsify it, and cannot produce it in the cell that could. A second, compounding objection: even taken at face value, 'expert ALFWorld trajectories of the same task type are interchangeable' is close to a property of the bank — Measurement C already shows a fixed three-exemplar static prompt recovers +12.4 of the ~+27 net k3 gain, i.e. most same-type item content is the type procedure — so the null generalizes to scorer papers only weakly, and the interesting positive result (tau_S >= 12 for self-written items) sits in the smaller arm at 2 seeds.
what_would_fix_it: Three changes, in order of importance. (1) Move the headline to a composition that can express within-class spread and fund it: make C2 (item as sole same-type carrier) the decision cell at 4 seeds and enough games to reach ~64 paired re-runs per item for 40 E items, and demote C1 to the bounding arm. (2) Add a within-class graded-quality positive control among *helpful* items — expert trajectories degraded by known, calibrated amounts (truncated at the penultimate procedure step, correct procedure with a wrong receptacle, verbose paraphrase) planted at a designed within-E spread — and require the estimator to recover that known tau before any null is scored. The current gate, which uses the between-class E+W separation, does not test the quantity P1 asserts. (3) Score P4 and P6 as residuals against the plug-in curves computed from the measured tau and sigma, with a pre-registered discrepancy bound, rather than as bands that are already implied by P1/P2/P3; and either raise backbone 2 to at least 32 paired re-runs per item or drop P7(b) and state P7(c)'s falsifier relative to the measured attenuation ceiling sqrt(R1 R2) instead of an absolute 0.3.
missing_baseline: A noise-robust multi-coalition estimator on the same reliability-versus-cost axis as fixed-composition LOO. The proposal's own closest prior work (Data Banzhaf, 2205.15466) exists precisely because LOO is the least noise-robust semivalue and the Banzhaf value the robust one; here the Banzhaf-style two-coalition average appears only inside the small additivity cell (768 episodes, class-level test), while every headline curve — reliability R(m), split-half Spearman, winner's-curse retention, pruning precision — is computed for single-composition LOO alone. A reviewer will demand the same curves for a two-or-more-coalition estimator at matched LLM-call budget: if between-item signal appears under randomized co-retrieved sets but not under fixed-composition LOO, the paper's headline is 'LOO in one composition has no signal', not 'there is no item to credit', and the cited prior work predicts exactly that outcome. Secondary omission: a same-item duplicate arm (two surface variants of the identical trajectory) to establish the surface-noise floor of tau, which would separate content variance from formatting variance in tau_S.
preprint_collision: No verified collision. Channel report: all six of my queries were answered by the s2cli channel (S2 + HF, both reported ok); WebSearch was unavailable in this session and was not used; WebFetch not used. (i) mechanism, unrestricted — 'between-item variance decomposition of counterfactual credit for retrieved memory items in LLM agents': returned AttriMem 2607.21106, MemQ 2605.08374, TreeMem-adjacent and counterfactual-RL work (CoRT 2607.25659, 2603.21563), none decomposing item value into between-item and replicate components. (ii) mechanism, --recent — 'how many repeated evaluations are needed for a stable per-item value rank, reliability, split-half, data valuation noise': returned Signal and Noise 2508.13144, IRT for LLM judges 2602.00521, ReliableEval 2505.22169, Don't Pass@k 2510.04265 — the reliability machinery, but at benchmark/judge level, never at item level. (iii) closest named method — 'Data Banzhaf robust data valuation ranking stability under stochastic learning noise': did not surface Banzhaf (same failure the proposal honestly reports); returned Data Shapley 1904.02868, Bagging stability 2301.12600, model stability vs seed 1909.10447. (iv) --recent, winner's curse / noisy utility pruning: nothing relevant (2608.08389 is token-budget pruning). (v) --recent, LOO value of individual in-context demonstrations: returned On Randomness in Agentic Evals 2602.07150 and 2602.11619, i.e. run-to-run variance at the system level, not per-item value. (vi) home vocabulary, no agent/memory words, variance components and Spearman-Brown: returned Quantifying Variance in Evaluation Benchmarks 2406.10229 and validity-scaling work, nothing on per-item counterfactual value. Verifications: 2205.15466 VERIFIED (AISTATS, 196 cit), 1904.02868 VERIFIED, 2406.04606 VERIFIED (ICML), 2305.19998 VERIFIED (ACL), 2605.04811 VERIFIED (TreeMem), 2507.04480 VERIFIED (PKDD/ECML workshop, 'Source Attribution in RAG'), 2607.21106 and 2605.08374 confirmed present via search; arxiv:2605.00944 (SCARV) NOT FOUND on S2 or HF — the Related Work leans on it as the nearest 'stable sample ranking' work and I could not verify it exists, which the authors must fix. Judging the proposal's own check: it is above the round's average — five queries, channel named for each, IDs given, and one honest report of a retrieval failure repaired by a direct paper lookup. Its weakness is that all its 'home' queries are Shapley-flavored, so it missed the psychometric / evaluation-reliability home where its actual methodological ancestors live (2508.13144, 2406.10229, 2505.22169, 2602.07150). That is not a collision, but it means the proposal argues novelty against the data-valuation literature only, while the variance-versus-noise decomposition it performs is standard practice one level up.
